studio.opt_policy_text:
STUDIO POLICIES
1. Online pre-registration is required. There will be a waitlist option, should space become available.
2. Cancellations must be received within 4 hours of class beginning.
3. Late Cancels and no-shows will be charged, Classes expire after 1 year of first booking.
4. Classes will be capped at 65 people in the Large room and 55 in the small room.
5. Upon entering, please sanitize your hands (hand sanitizer will be available)
6. During class, rows will rotate to give everyone the opportunity to have a closer view to the mirror and instructor.
7.No FOOD or outside drinks will be allowed in the studio (coffee, soda, juice, etc.) except for water. Water must be in a sealed container.
8. Limit personal belongings to essentials only. 

PRIVATE LESSONS
1. Private Lessons are 45 mintues
2. Private Lessons require a minimum of 24 hours for cancellations or re-booking.
3. Private lesson can be shared up to 2 people.
4. Small Group Private lessons up to 6 people, will require for 1 individual to book for the entire group. Client will be responsible for recruitment of group members

CREDIT PACKS
1. Team credits are available on the APP - If you are on multiple teams you qualify for discounts, please contact our Admin Maria or Jennifer in the office or call 619.758.5209 or email at admin@majestyinmotion.com
2. No refunds on New Student Specials or unlimited passes

STUDIO STUDENT
CODE OF CONDUCT
1. Respect and Courtesy
- Treat everyone with respect and support each other's efforts.
2. Attendance and Punctuality
- Arrive on time and notify instructors in advance if you can’t attend.
3. Dress Code
- Wear appropriate dance attire and maintain personal grooming.
4. Focus and Participation
- Engage fully in class and respect instructors’ feedback.
5. Safety and Well-Being
- Follow safety guidelines and inform instructors of any health concerns.
6. Teamwork and Collaboration
- Promote teamwork and celebrate each other's achievements.
7. Sexual Harassment Policy
- Zero tolerance for sexual harassment. Report any incidents immediately.
8. Conflict Resolution
- Address conflicts respectfully; seek instructor assistance if needed.
9. Social Media and Privacy
- Respect privacy when posting on social media and obtain permissions.
10. Commitment to Growth
- Set personal goals and embrace learning opportunities.
11. Consequences for Misconduct
- Violations may result in disciplinary action, including dismissal.

By following this Code of Conduct, we create a positive and inspiring environment for all dancers. Let's make our studio a place of creativity and growth!

TEAM MEMBERSHIP
1. Team Memberships are due on the 1st of the month.
2. Late payments received or unsuccessful payments after the 5th of the month, will receive a $10 late fee. 
3. Team memberships must be canceled within a 10-day notice prior to the next billing cycle.
4.  No refunds on New Student Specials

salsa.title: Level 1 Salsa
salsa.description:
This class is designed for all levels. In this beginner class, you will learn the basic Salsa steps and turns, along with rhythm, timing, lead, and follow techniques. 
No partner is needed!

salsa.title: Level 2 Salsa
salsa.description:
Level up your Salsa - In this class, we'll review the basics and introduce you to more cross-body lead variations and turns. 

*You must know your Cross Body Lead, basic right and left turns, and you must understand timing.

You may be asked to sit out in class if you do not meet these requirements.

salsa.title: Level 2 Salsa - Footwork
salsa.description:
This class is highly recommended for those who want to advance to the next level.

Level 2 Salsa, this class is 1 hour of Salsa shines/footwork. Right/Left turns, suzy q's, front double basics, hook turns, hook steps, and more! A fun class that helps you connect with your partner.

salsa.title: Level 2 Salsa - Partnerwork
salsa.description:
The Level 2 Partnerwork class is 1 hour of partnerwork. The benefit of this class is that we have more time to practice to music and more detail is offered.

*You must know your Cross Body Lead, basic right and left turns, and you must understand timing.

You may be asked to sit out in class if you do not meet these requirements.

salsa.title: Salsa Calena
salsa.description:
Level 1 Salsa Caleña

In this beginner-friendly class, you will learn the fundamentals of salsa caleña—basic steps, turns, musicality, and speed—to build confidence, rhythm, and have lots of fun.
No partner needed.

bachata.title: Level 1 Bachata
bachata.description:
Beginner Bachata focuses on all the basic steps, turns, and you will learn how to lead/follow.
No partner needed

bachata.title: Level 2 Bachata
bachata.description:
Level 2 Bachata is the next step after you have a strong foundation of all your basics. 
In this class we introduce moves that include direction changes, variety of hand tosses and turns. Must know their basics, left & right turn, and comfortable with different connections. 

*You may asked to sit out in class if you do not meet the requirements

bachata.title: Level 3 Bachata
bachata.description:
Level 3 Bachata
*must know direction changes are definite, including outside turns and spot turns, with hand configurations (open, thumb-to-palm) and frame options (open, semi-closed).

You may be asked to sit out of class if you do not meet these requirements

bachata.title: Traditional Bachata Class
bachata.description: Open-Level Traditional Bachata. Explore roots, musical structure, and rhythm sections, with step progressions from foundational to advanced for confident social dancing.

mambo.title: Level 1 Mambo (Salsa ON2)
mambo.description:
This class is designed for all levels. In this beginner class, you will learn the basic Mambo (Salsa ON2)steps and turns, along with rhythm, timing, lead, and follow techniques. 
No partner is needed!

mambo.title: Level 2 Mambo (Salsa ON2)
mambo.description:
Level up your Mambo (Salsa ON2) - In this class, we'll review the basics and introduce you to more cross-body lead variations and turns. 

*You must know your Cross Body Lead, basic right and left turns, and you must understand timing.

You may be asked to sit out in class if you do not meet these requirements.

mambo.title: Level 3 & 4 On2 Training Team
mambo.description:
*Must have an instructor's approval to join.
 
2 Hours of Intensive Training!
Footwork, Partnerwork, Intricate Turn Patterns, Body Movement, and faster music!

*Must meet level 3 requirements!

mambo.title: Level 3 Mambo (Salsa On2)
mambo.description:
*Must be able to do double turns
This is a fast-paced class. Strong fundamentals are required! You must also understand Mambo timing.
**You may be asked to sit out of class if you do not meet these requirements.

Level 3 Mambo class, you will learn more footwork and partnerwork, and double turn variations. Learn quicker transitions and more body movement.

cha cha cha.title: Cha Cha Cha Footwork
cha cha cha.description: In this class, you will learn some energetic, fun Cha Cha Cha steps! ALL levels

cha cha cha.title: Level 1 Cha Cha Cha
cha cha cha.description: Cha Cha Cha combo class! Basic steps with partnering. No Partner needed.

enhance.title: Ballet for Adults
enhance.description:
In this class, we will focus on basic ballet moves that can help you with other dance styles. This includes balance, control, endurance and strength. This class is open for all levels and is beginner friendly.
What to bring:
Ballet Flats or socks
Dancewear

enhance.title: Body Movement
enhance.description: In this class, you will learn how to move your body more fluidly. With a focus on body isolations, foot placements, and body awareness. These tools will help you in any dance genre you are learning!

enhance.title: Bootcamp
enhance.description: 2 hour bootcamps to kick start you to the next level!

enhance.title: FREE Beginner Bachata
enhance.description:
You will learn all your basic Bachata steps and turns. 
Learn how to connect with your partner so you can lead/follow at ease.

enhance.title: FREE Beginner Mambo
enhance.description:
Beginner Mambo (dancing ON2) 
In this class, you will learn how to do all your basic steps, turns, and you will learn how to lead/follow a cross-body lead.

enhance.title: FREE Beginner Salsa
enhance.description: In this class, you will learn all your basic steps and turns. Perfect for both new dancers and experienced dancers looking to refine their foundation.

enhance.title: FREE Intro to Salsa and Bachata
enhance.description: In this class, you will learn 30 minutes of footwork of both Salsa and Bachata. Great first timer class!

enhance.title: FREE Level 2 Bachata
enhance.description: Level 2 Bachata is the next step after you have a strong foundation of all your basics!

enhance.title: FREE Level 2 Mambo
enhance.description: Level 2 Mambo class offers a variety of footwork and partnerwork, incorporating more cross-body lead combos, fine-tuning turns, and you will learn how to connect to the music so you can dance better with your partner.

enhance.title: FREE Salsa Level 2
enhance.description: In this class, we will review all the basic steps, but you will learn a variety of combinations. Learn how to lead/follow left turns. You will learn how to connect more to the music and your partner.

enhance.title: Heels
enhance.description:
Heels class focuses on building confidence and learning fundamental movements in heels. These moves include posture, balance, proper walking, body awareness, and basic choreography, which helps develop core strength and fluidity. Open for all level and beginner freindly. 
What to bring:
Comfortable heels (preferably with ankle support)
Comfortable dancewear
knee pads

enhance.title: Open Practice Sessions
enhance.description:
Open practice sessions! Use the room to practice your dance moves! 
*FREE for Team Members

enhance.title: Technique Class
enhance.description:
HIGHLY RECOMMENDED FOR ALL LEVELS! The details in this class help you move to the next level.

Our technique class is great for anyone to take! Learn more about connection, timing, and rhythm so you can dance better with your partner!

classes.title: FREE Intro to Salsa & Bachata
classes.description: This class is perfect for anyone who wants to try out our studio! It's FREE! 30 minutes of Salsa footwork and 30 minutes of Bachata footwork!
